text:
jamie: Quick postmortem follow-up - consolidating action items for rollout/flag hardening. We saw the same pattern: wide flag + default-on = blast. Need owners, measurable targets, and a short verification plan.

leila: I can take the auto-rollback implementation. Thinking: a two-stage rollback (soft reroute + hard revert) triggered by a composite signal. Target: detect+start soft-reroute within 90s, full revert within 4m. ETA 12 business days. I'll sketch design and the controller tests.

tom: I'll own flag governance: require "risk_tier" and "default_state" metadata, plus a checklist on rollout windows. New policy: any flag that touches routing, model selection, or billing must be default_state=false unless explicit exception approved. ETA 5 days for validator + migration plan.

sre-ryan: For recurring patterns, can we add a weekly scan that finds flags created in the last 30d with default_state=true and impact on inference? That will catch accidental wide-on flags. I can add a job.

ops-bot: Tickets created: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-2001|INF-2001> auto-rollback (leila), <https://tracker/redwood/INF-2002|INF-2002> flag governance (tom), <https://tracker/redwood/INF-2003|INF-2003> blast-radius harness (sre-ryan).

leila: Proposed Prom rule for candidate rollback: 
```
alert: RolloutSafetyTrip
expr: (increase(errors_total[4m]) / increase(requests_total[4m]) > 0.007) or (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 1.8 * baseline_p50)
for: 2m
labels: {severity: "critical", action: "rollback-candidate"}
```
We'll pump this into the rollout-operator which will mark the execution as quarantined and start soft reroute.

jamie: Good. Add a short runbook snippet to INF-2001 for oncall: how to force a soft reroute, how to pin traffic away, and where to find the last-stable artifact. Also include the SLA: full revert <= 4m for high-impact flags.

tom: Flag metadata example I'm adding to the registry: 
```
flag_name: semantic_reranker_v3
owners: ["tom"]
risk_tier: high
default_state: false
rollout_window: 30m
allowed_targets: staging,canary
```
I'll add a validator that blocks `default_state: true` for risk_tier in [high,critical] unless `approved_by` is set.

sre-ryan: Blast-radius harness plan: small chaos runner that simulates 20-200 concurrent requests with increased error injection, then verifies rollback sequence. We'll run in staging and one customer-sim cluster. ETA 8 days. Need a short access request ticket for cluster creds.

leila: Tests I'll add: unit rollback path, integration that replays the postmortem request trace (I'll attach sanitized trace to INF-2001), and an end-to-end that verifies traffic split mechanics.

jamie: Please add explicit metrics to tickets: detection latency, time-to-soft-reroute, time-to-full-revert, and false-positive rate tolerance. Owners: put ETAs in the tickets by EOD tomorrow.

tom: I'll schedule a 20m sync with SRE + rollout-operator pair tomorrow to walk through validator and exception flows.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly check-in scheduled Fri 09:30 for a 15m status update on INF-2001/2002/2003.

jamie: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers (infra access or rollout-operator gaps), ping me or @sre-ryan. We'll prioritize whatever blocks the revert path first. :white_check_mark:
